notes: The assigned original reference matches the primary article title and DOI. However, study_o and description are null and locators_o is empty. Printed candidate evidence, not selected targets: Table 3 (p. 418), Model 1 ever-arrested participants n=2,838: within-individual Marriage coefficient −.299, SE .045, p<.001; between-individual Marriage coefficient −.534, SE .064, p<.001. Model 2 ever-married/ever-arrested n=813: within-individual Divorce .418, SE .093, p<.001, and Legal separation .464, SE .135, p<.001. Model 3 male n=505: within-individual Divorce .438, SE .123, p<.001; Model 4 female n=308: within-individual Divorce .392, SE .141, p<.01. Table 4 (p. 421), discontinuous change models, n=813/505/308 for combined/male/female participants: within-individual Divorce .493/.554/.439, SE .099/.133/.144, p<.001/p<.001/p<.01; Time since divorce −.005/−.006/−.005 has no significance stars (no exact p printed; no numerical nonsignificance bound inferred). Table 5 (p. 422), first-marriage duration groups 1–11/12–23/24–35/36+ months, participant n=121/120/142/430: within-individual Divorce .113/−.442/.465/.522, SE .228/.396/.151/.107, with no stars/no stars/p<.01/p<.001. Within-individual Single in the 1–11-month group is −.696, SE .141, p<.001. Other relationship and control coefficients are also reported in these tables. Metric identity is sourced to the logit equation on p. 415: coefficients model log-odds of arrest; table legends define Coeff. as coefficient. These printed coefficients are not ORs and no exponentiation or metric conversion was performed. Candidate model participant Ns are printed directly, not inferred from df, recruitment total, or monthly-observation means. Table 2 p. 412 gives descriptive ever-arrested n=2,959 and ever-married/ever-arrested n=844, with parental-education missing-data counts including n=813; these descriptive totals do not override model headers. Monthly observations are a separate role and no total analytic observation count is established for the unspecified target. No N sum was used.
